summary.headline: Gnomon and Noon Shadows
summary.text: Instructions for constructing and leveling a conical gnomon, using a circle and three measurements to establish perpendicularity to the horizon. It defines the meridian or noon shadow and explains shadow-of-feet and shadow-of-digits measures, including the almanac table of daily noon shadows.
